generic_observation_fields.meaning: Was an actual choice made, not merely a feeling or ongoing plan?
Was a felt, non-analytical signal perceived in the present moment?
Was the felt signal brief and once-only rather than later repeatable?
Did that signal materially settle an important decision?
Did the respondent hear their OWN words while speaking with someone?
Was the hearer a trusted listener?
Did listening to their own voice determine the choice?
Was there an observed rise and fall of emotional highs/lows?
Did the waves themselves settle an important choice?
Was structured analysis used over time?
Did insufficient environmental facts delay an important choice?
Was success or fit of the chosen action independently checkable?
What activates or suppresses use of a mode; separates capacity, choice, and inertia
